source: &1069 Jesus Christ...
&1446 What the Hell happened in here?
target: &1446 这里到底发生了什么？

source: &1447 Did someone get to Van der Waal before he could talk?
target: &1447 有人在范德瓦尔开口之前，对他下手了？

source: &1070 Maybe it's a domestic gone bad...
target: &1070 也许是家庭纠纷失控了……

source: &409 The blackmailer said nothing about this - possibly  didn't even expect this themselves.
target: &409 勒索者可没提过这件事，也许连对方都没料到。

source: &410 Still, you need to find what they demanded, before the whole apartment is picked apart by forensic drones.
target: &410 不过，你还是得赶在鉴证无人机把整套公寓翻个底朝天之前，找到对方要的东西。

source: &411 The body of Giel's husband lies in the jacuzzi, face up. He appears to have been shot several times.
target: &411 吉尔丈夫的尸体仰面躺在按摩浴池里，看起来中了好几枪。

source: &1071 This is Dakarai Van der Waal, Giel's husband.
target: &1071 这是达卡莱·范德瓦尔，吉尔的丈夫。

source: &1072 I can see four gunshot wounds in his chest. It was either these, or he drowned, but that's kind of academic at this stage.
target: &1072 胸口能看见四处枪伤。不是中枪死的，就是淹死的，不过眼下争这个也没什么意义。

source: &412 A jacuzzi sits in the corner of the room. You wonder what kind of man needs to have a pool quite so readily available at all times.
target: &412 房间角落里有个按摩浴池。你不禁想，究竟什么人需要随时随地都能泡进池子里。

source: &1448 There's something at the bottom of the pool...a pistol?
target: &1448 池底好像有东西……一把手枪？

source: &1073 Our murder weapon?
target: &1073 我们的凶器？

source: &8449 One of them, maybe. It's too deep to reach.
target: &8449 也许是其中一件。太深了，够不着。

source: &1463 Not without severely contaminating the crimescene, anyway.
target: &1463 除非严重污染现场，否则够不着。

source: &1450 I can just about make out a pistol at the bottom through the mess.
target: &1450 隔着这些污物，我勉强能看见池底有把手枪。

source: &1464 Careful how you get it out, though.
target: &1464 不过，取出来的时候得小心。

source: &1465 You're the one who's always lecturing me about contaminating scenes with DNA, after all.
target: &1465 毕竟，老教训我别把自己的 DNA 留在现场的，可就是你。

source: &1451 If there's anything else in there, it'll be the forensic team's job to find it.
target: &1451 要是里面还有别的东西，就让鉴证小组去找吧。

source: &413 After a couple of tugs, the hanger comes loose.
target: &413 拉扯几下，衣架就松脱了。

source: Picked up: Hanger
target: 已拾取：衣架

source: &414 The wire coathanger seems to be stuck in the join between the floor and the floordrobe.
target: &414 铁丝衣架好像卡在地板和地柜的接缝里。

source: &415 This pad appears to control the floor-mounted wardrobe. The panel seems to be showing an error message.
target: &415 这块面板似乎控制着嵌入地板的衣柜，上面好像显示着错误信息。

source: &416 From a diagram on the panel, it looks like it's linked to the floordrobe.
target: &416 看面板上的示意图，它应该连接着地柜。

source: &417 T.H.E. Systems FLOORDROBE - STORAGE CONTROL[[General Error 151: Mechanical Error[Please ensure there are no obstructions to opening your T.H.E. Systems FLOORDROBE, and try again.
target: &417 T.H.E. 系统地柜——储物控制[[常规错误 151：机械故障[请确认没有物品阻碍 T.H.E. 系统地柜开启，然后重试。

source: &1074 See anything interesting?
target: &1074 有什么有意思的东西吗？

source: &1452 There's an empty gun rack in here.
target: &1452 里面有个空枪架。

source: &1453 Ammunition, maintenance tools, cleaning spray...but no gun.
target: &1453 弹药、保养工具、清洁喷剂……就是没枪。

source: &1075 In their closet?
target: &1075 放在衣柜里？

source: &1454 Maybe it's their 'outdoor' gear. There's fishing equipment in here as well.
target: &1454 也许是他们的‘户外’装备，里面还有钓鱼用具。

source: Picked up: Fishing Rod
target: 已拾取：钓竿

source: &1076 Are you taking stuff again?
target: &1076 你又在拿东西？

source: &1455 It might be useful. Call it a hunch.
target: &1455 也许用得着。就当是直觉吧。

source: &418 There's nothing worth taking from here, except the fact that one of the pistols is missing.
target: &418 这里没什么值得拿的东西，但有一把手枪不见了，这点值得记住。

source: &419 As pleasing as it would be to make a start at bringing some order to the chaos of this room, this small act of tidying would be ultimately futile.
target: &419 能把这间乱七八糟的屋子收拾出点头绪，固然令人欣慰，可这点小小的整理终究无济于事。

source: &420 An expensive-looking fishing rod sits in the closet. It doesn't appear that it's been used in a while.
target: &420 衣柜里放着一根看起来很贵的钓竿，似乎有段时间没用过了。

source: &1456 I think I'll leave anything else in there to the forensic team.
target: &1456 里面其他的东西，还是留给鉴证小组吧。

source: &421 What on earth do you expect to fish for? You don't even know what's in the pool.
target: &421 你到底想钓什么？你连池子里有什么都不知道。

source: &1077 Nothing biting?
target: &1077 没鱼咬钩？

source: &1457 There's nothing on the end of the line. No way I can hook that pistol.
target: &1457 鱼线末端什么都没装，没法钩住那把手枪。

source: &1458 The hook sinks, but I can't catch that pistol at the bottom.
target: &1458 鱼钩沉下去了，可还是钩不到池底的手枪。

source: &1459 Got it!
&1078 The murder weapon?
&1460 One of them, anyway. Why is it in the jacuzzi, though?
target: &1460 至少是其中一件。不过，怎么会在按摩浴池里？

source: &1079 What we really need is a witness.
target: &1079 我们真正需要的是个证人。

source: &1461 I'd better not drop anything in there.
target: &1461 还是别往里面扔东西了。

source: &1462 I think that I'd lose anything that goes in there, like that pistol.
target: &1462 这把手枪就是例子，什么东西掉进去，我大概都拿不回来了。

source: &422 An old-fashioned chemical photograph in a silver portrait sits by the bed.
target: &422 床边放着一个银色相框，里面是一张老式的胶片照片。

source: Picked up: Photograph
target: 已拾取：照片

source: &423 Standing out from the festival of gore is a human hand. It appears to be fairly intact.
target: &423 血肉狼藉之中，有一只人手格外显眼，看起来还算完整。

source: Picked up: Hand
target: 已拾取：人手

source: &1463 How do you open one of these things?
target: &1463 这东西怎么打开？

source: &1080 App, remote, trance, control panel...could be anywhere.
target: &1080 应用程序、遥控器、迷境、控制面板……哪种都有可能。

source: &1464 Yeah, real helpful, Max.
target: &1464 嗯，可真有帮助啊，麦克斯。

source: &424 A floor-mounted wardrobe - or 'floordrobe' - lies in wait beneath the bedroom.
target: &424 卧室的地板下藏着一座嵌入式衣柜，也就是所谓的‘地柜’。

source: &425 Much as you'd love to bring some order to this chaos, putting things away in the floordrobe won't make a significant enough difference.
target: &425 虽然你很想把这片混乱收拾出点头绪，但把东西放进地柜，并不会改善多少。

source: Picked up: Pistol
target: 已拾取：手枪

source: &1465 It's like they had an industrial accident...
target: &1465 跟出了工业事故似的……

source: &1081 ...in the bedroom?
&1466 I don't think so, it'd just contaminate the evidence.
target: &1466 还是算了，只会污染证据。

source: &1467 I think I'm carrying as much of Van der Waal around as I want to.
target: &1467 我身上带着的范德瓦尔的零件，已经够多了。

source: &1468 I don't think I can justify taking that.
target: &1468 拿走那个，我可找不出理由。

source: &1469 I have no idea who that's supposed to be.
target: &1469 完全看不出这画的是谁。

source: &1082 Shall I trance it for you?
target: &1082 要我去迷境查一下吗？

source: &1470 There's no such thing as comfortable ignorance anymore, is there?
target: &1470 现在连什么都不知道、图个清静的权利都没有了，是吧？

source: &1083 Huh? You old people are weird.
target: &1083 啊？你们老年人真奇怪。
